messages:
maya: Starting deploy for model-router:v2 — kicking off canary. Target cohorts: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 45m. Release notes: minor routing tweak, kv-cache key rename.
jon: ack. I'll watch p99 latency and token errors.
deploy-bot: Deploy job 71234 accepted. Canary instance set: pool-us-west-2-a. Helm revision: 42.
nina: flipping feature flag `ff_model_route_v2` to 5% now via ops console.
maya: posting quick command in case we need to revert:
```
/feature-flag set ff_model_route_v2 --cohort=5 --actor=maya --reason="canary start"
```
zach: grabbing logs from canary: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy-router-canary` — will paste anomalies.
ops-bot: Alert configured: if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p99 latency +50ms -> notify #eng-oncall and pause ramp.
jon: saw a small spike at +8m, but under threshold. No action.
maya: ok, advance to 20% in 10m if stable.
deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck passed (20/20 checks). Advancing to 20%. Updating ff to 20%.
nina: command used:
```
/feature-flag set ff_model_route_v2 --cohort=20 --actor=nina --reason="canary advance"
```
zach: traffic slice logs show slight increase in kv-cache misses for one shard, investigating cache warming.
jon: p99 increased by 22ms on canary at 20% — within alert but watch closely.
maya: keep ramp paused for 5m while zach checks cache. If no user-facing errors, proceed.
zach: warming paths applied, patch queued to bump prefetch window. Rolling patch to canary nodes.
ops-bot: Patch roll started on canary (patch-id: patch-983). Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Patch applied; healthchecks green.
maya: ok push to 50% now. Nina please apply flag.
nina: applying: `/feature-flag set ff_model_route_v2 --cohort=50 --actor=nina --reason="canary success - ramp to 50"`
jon: after ramp to 50%, I see a correlation with error 502s from a downstream model at ~+2m. Small spike to 0.8%.
maya: Not good. Recommendation: immediate rollback to previous flag state (route back to v1) for safety, hold deploy.
zach: +1 on rollback, downstream instability looks like overload on v2 path.
maya: nina, please set ff back to 0% cohort and pin service to model-router:v1 for canary traffic.
nina: rolling back flag to 0% now. Command:
```
/feature-flag set ff_model_route_v2 --cohort=0 --actor=nina --reason="rollback - downstream errors"
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag update acknowledged. Cohort now 0%. Draining in-flight requests.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2023-712 - downstream 502 spike during ff ramp.
jon: monitoring after rollback — error rate trending back to baseline. p99 latency returning.
maya: great. We'll abort the rest of the rollout. Action items: 1) create a short postmortem with timeline and logs, 2) add a pre-warm step to the ramp plan to avoid cold-kv misses, 3) re-run canary with patched caching.
zach: I'll open PR with cache prefetch and a small canary-only config param.
nina: tagging oncall for follow-up and adding a release note entry: "aborted v2 rollout due to downstream overload; rollback to v1 for canary while patching cache prefetch."
deploy-bot: Deploy job 71234 marked: ABORTED. Rollback completed.
maya: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after PR and a short soak test. :thumbsup:
